title.purpose: Card titles, profile names, panel headers.

label.purpose: Eyebrow tags, button text, status-pill text.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card, panel, and surface.

shadows.name: ember-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons, brand mark, and other elements that should announce themselves as the important action.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus state — a solid ring, not a blurred glow.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: Border-via-shadow trick on circular avatar/profile images.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The one deliberately heavier shadow — reserved for the bottom-sheet address picker.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's one confident action — pill-shaped, ember gradient, glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6a1a, #f25c10); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(242, 92, 16, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 20px 38px rgba(242, 92, 16, 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.18), 0 16px 32px rgba(242, 92, 16, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/secondary action — pill-shaped, hairline border, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 36, 48, 0.08); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); color: #1f2430; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.10); }

components.name: Food Card
components.description: Signature dish/listing card — photo, title, price, hover lift.
components.css: .ds-food-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); border: 1px solid rgba(31, 36, 48, 0.08); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgba(31, 36, 48, 0.08); transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-food-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-food-card__photo { aspect-ratio: 1.22 / 1; border-radius: 16px; background-size: cover; background-position: center; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-food-card:hover .ds-food-card__photo { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-food-card__body { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-food-card__title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #1f2430; } .ds-food-card__price { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; color: #ff6a1a; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input — hairline border at rest, hard focus ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 56px; width: 100%; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 36, 48, 0.08); background: #fffdfb; color: #1f2430; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6f7483; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff6a1a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.10); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Unified status component covering order status, delivery status, and any future status surface via state-color mapping.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-pill--pending { background: rgba(255, 143, 61, 0.14); color: #a95f19; } .ds-status-pill--success { background: #eef8eb; color: #3a7d34; } .ds-status-pill--progress { background: #fff1e7; color: #c1490f; } .ds-status-pill--danger { background: rgba(222, 95, 88, 0.14); color: #a13030; }

components.name: Icon FAB
components.description: Floating circular action button (back / language switch) — lighter, more translucent than in-flow buttons.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Volver"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #1f2430; box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgba(31, 36, 48, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-fab:hover { color: #ff6a1a; }

components.name: Courier Payout Card
components.description: Signature earnings display on the courier profile — ember gradient wash, large Display-weight amount.
components.css: .ds-payout-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.1), rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.03)); border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-payout-card__label { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #6f7483; } .ds-payout-card__amount { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; color: #1f2430; }

narrative.overview: CUCU exists because someone nearby cooked one plate too many. Every visual decision should read as a neighbor handing you food directly — not a restaurant scrolling its permanent menu, not a delivery aggregator's endless catalog. The system is warm and appetite-forward by design: a cream-and-ember palette, big honest food photography, and soft, fully-rounded shapes that feel closer to bakery signage or a farmers-market stall than a SaaS dashboard. Nothing here should feel sterile, corporate, or algorithmic — the product's entire premise is human-scale surplus, and the interface should feel that way even on its most transactional screens (checkout, order tracking, courier payouts). The palette stays almost entirely warm neutrals (cream, paper-white, charcoal ink) punctuated by a single confident ember orange used for action and status, never as a large flat fill. Depth comes from soft, color-tinted shadows rather than hard edges or pure-black elevation — nothing in this system should look like it was clipped out with scissors.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, appetite-forward, human-scale — never corporate or sterile
One confident accent (ember orange) used for action/status, not decoration
Fully rounded everywhere: pill for anything interactive, sweeping large radii for containers
Shadows are always color-tinted (ink or ember), never neutral black
Real food photography and one illustrated 'phone in hand' hero moment, not stock-icon abstraction

rules.name: The Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Ember orange is the color you act on, not the color you read. It appears on buttons, focus rings, active states, price, and the brand mark — never as body text, never as a large background fill. The one exception is a very low-alpha radial wash (~8%) behind hero content, which is atmosphere, not a color block.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Sage #5aa851 is the only success/positive color in the system. Several screens currently use unrelated greens (#1eae7a, #19a57b, #7ea86f) — those are drift from before this file existed, not sanctioned variants; converge them to Sage.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Anything set in Outfit at Display or Headline size carries negative letter-spacing (−0.04em minimum). A headline with default tracking reads as off-system immediately.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow always tells you what's beneath it: ink-tinted for resting surfaces, ember-tinted for actionable ones. A generic rgba(0,0,0,…) shadow is off-system outside the Address Picker's Sheet exception.

rules.name: The Soft-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every interactive surface is rounded. A 0px/sharp-cornered button or card is off-system; use the smallest radius in the scale (14px) before ever using none.

dos: Do use pill radius (999px) for every button, chip, badge, FAB, and nav element — the one unified shape language.
Do reserve Ember Orange for action, status, and price — as a gradient, glow, or thin line, never a large flat fill.
Do tint every shadow — ink for resting/ambient, ember for primary actions — per the Warm Shadow Rule.
Do pair Outfit (tight tracking) with Manrope; no third typeface.
Do keep food photography as full-bleed rectangles inside a card's own radius, never circular crops.
Do extend the unified Status Pill component with a new state-color mapping when a new status is needed.
donts: Don't introduce a new hex for ember, sage, ink, danger, or warning. The auth pages' #ff6a17/#24262f/#73727c family and the app-shell's other greens (#1eae7a, #19a57b, #7ea86f) are legacy drift, not alternate brand colors — converge to the values in this file.
Don't ship a 16px-radius button anywhere going forward; pill is the one canonical button shape now.
Don't add a bottom tab bar on mobile — navigation stacks into a column below 760px.
Don't hand-roll a new badge/status class — extend the unified Status Pill instead.
Don't use a neutral/pure-black shadow outside the Address Picker's Sheet exception, and don't use emoji for a primary functional icon.
